description: How an output column of a defining-SQL object derives from its source column(s).

enum.name: IDENTITY
enum.description: The output value is exactly one source column, unchanged by any function, cast, or arithmetic (an 'as' alias still counts as identity).

enum.name: AGGREGATE
enum.description: The output is a SQL set/aggregate function (e.g. COUNT, MAX) over its inputs.

enum.name: EXPRESSION
enum.description: The output is a non-aggregate transformation over one or more source columns.

enum.name: LITERAL
enum.description: The output is a constant with no source column input.
